trigger: Full-pool financing sweep (see financing-evidence-ledger-06.json for the full methodology and the zero-hit majority, and financing-evidence-ledger-07.json for the confirmed real financings). These 10 candidates had at least one filing land inside their T-90-to-T+30 window that, on individual reading, turned out NOT to represent real financing to the issuer: pure resale registrations, bare shelf registrations with no accompanying takedown, a merger/reorganization proxy, and two same-holder share-for-warrant exchanges that raised no new capital.
qualification_rule: Count only actual issuer equity, equity-linked, or debt capital raised from T-90 through T+30. A filing landing in the window is necessary but not sufficient - it must represent genuine new capital to the issuer.

rows.evidence_summary: The only in-window filing is a resale-registration prospectus supplement (424B3, Prospectus Supplement No. 4 to a May 2025 Form S-1 resale registration): "relate to the resale from time to time by the selling securityholders...of up to 54,584,250 American Depositary Shares." This registers existing holders' shares for resale; it is not a new issuance of capital to the company, and no accompanying primary 424B5/S-1 appears in the window.

The only in-window filing (424B3, 2023-09-13) is a resale registration prospectus supplement; the document itself confirms the standard resale disclaimer language ("we will not receive any of the proceeds"). Not company financing.

The only in-window filing is an S-3 shelf registration (2024-06-10) with no accompanying prospectus supplement (424B) in the window. A bare shelf registration establishes future capacity to sell securities but confirms no actual issuance or proceeds.

The only in-window filing (8-K Item 1.01, 2024-12-19) discloses an exchange agreement in which existing holders (entities affiliated with EcoR1 Capital) exchanged 8,036,688 already-outstanding common shares for economically equivalent pre-funded warrants covering the same share count. No new capital was raised and share count outstanding was not increased by the transaction itself.
The only in-window filing is a bare S-3 shelf registration (2023-05-15) with no accompanying prospectus supplement (424B) in the window - establishes future capacity only, no actual issuance.
The only in-window filing is a bare S-3 shelf registration (2023-08-31) with no accompanying prospectus supplement (424B) in the window - establishes future capacity only, no actual issuance.

The only in-window filings are a bare S-3 shelf registration (2020-11-12) and its amendment (S-3/A, 2020-11-24), with no accompanying prospectus supplement (424B) in the window - establishes future capacity only, no actual issuance.

The only in-window filing (424B3, 2020-05-26) is a resale registration prospectus; the document confirms the standard resale disclaimer language ("we will not receive any of the proceeds"). Not company financing.

The only in-window filing (8-K Item 3.02, 2024-08-22) discloses exchange agreements in which existing institutional holders (RA Capital Healthcare Fund and another existing holder) exchanged an aggregate of 9,350,000 already-outstanding common shares for economically equivalent pre-funded warrants covering the same share count. No new capital was raised.

rows.issuer: Liquidia Technologies, Inc. (subsidiary of Liquidia Corporation)
rows.evidence_summary: The three in-window filings are: an S-3 shelf registration (2020-12-16) and its amendment (S-3/A, 2020-12-21), neither accompanied by an actual prospectus-supplement takedown in the window; and a 424B3 (2020-09-17) that is the proxy statement/prospectus for the Liquidia Technologies-to-Liquidia Corporation holding-company reorganization (a 1-for-1 corporate restructuring, already documented in historical-universe-ledger-44.json) - a merger/reorganization vote, not a capital-raising transaction.
